review_kind: static pre-execution Standards and safety review

checks.result: Fresh headless Firefox; viewport exactly 1280x1800; four uniquely named critical-point screenshots; no full_page screenshots.
Step/action logging and final observed datum; log reset before browser execution.
DOM evaluations and locator observations only read theme, submissions, row count and checked state; no injected state mutation.

Bounded intended UI writes: theme click once, literal milk fill, Add click once, checkbox click once. No arbitrary file reads, shell commands, package installs, model calls or credential access in generated source.
Generated file outputs are fixed screenshots and one log under the script parent; no dynamic path supplied by DOM.
Trusted runner forces viewport, blocks service workers, restricts browser requests to named loopback fixture GETs, and captures independent DOM observations before close.
Static profile denies external outbound network and host writes outside the task root/dev; protects named credential directories. This is not a complete host-read isolation boundary.
Reviewed inline fixture has no external resources or network APIs; intended theme/add/checkbox handlers mutate local page state.

execution_conditions: Use the exact reviewed script bytes, the hashed trusted runner, and the hashed sandbox profile; preserve this detached readonly snapshot.
Execute the run-folder copy in a fresh writable final_runs/run_<id> directory inside the authorized workspace; do not execute the root-level copy or overwrite an earlier evidence run.
Use a fresh no-credentials browser environment and the reviewed loopback fixture; no other host or authenticated tenant is approved.
Retain stdout/stderr, independent runner observations, screenshots and logs; acceptance requires separate current-run evidence and direct screenshot review.
limitations: Generated code was not executed or imported, and no browser was launched by this reviewer.
No visual, runtime, or product acceptance is asserted; plan critical points remain unverified before execution.
Absent the reviewed runner, the generated script itself does not enforce a browser network allowlist.
The strict milk checkbox locator can abort on duplicate rows; the trusted runner must preserve the error and final DOM evidence rather than treating absence of FINAL_RESPONSE as success.
Runner, sandbox and fixture are supporting artifacts outside the pinned Git snapshot; their hashes bind this approval to the inspected bytes.
original_source_fixes_review: preserved; outside this new review scope
